messages.content: 2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

message.content:
2015 年的國際象棋錦標賽（即第 42 屆世界團體奧林匹克）在阿塞拜疆巴庫舉行。最終排名如下：

| 名次 | 國家 | 獎牌 |
|------|------|------|
| 1 | 俄羅斯 | 金牌 |
| 2 | 中國 | 銀牌 |
| 3 | 烏克蘭 | 銅牌 |

因此，**俄羅斯隊以金牌獲勝**。如果你指的是「2015 年世界國際象棋冠軍賽」，那場比賽是馬格努斯·卡爾森（Magnus Carlsen）對陣謝爾蓋·卡爾基安（Sergey Karjakin），最終卡爾森成功保住了他的冠軍頭銜。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" They want the winner of the 2015 Chess Olympiad? Or maybe the World Chess Championship 2015? The question is ambiguous. But likely they refer to the 2015 Chess Olympiad. The 2015 Chess Olympiad was held in Baku, Azerbaijan. The winners were Russia (Gold), China (Silver), and Ukraine (Bronze). So answer: Russia won gold. If they ask about the World Chess Championship 2015, it was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin; Carlsen retained his title. So answer: Magnus Carlsen. Which one? The phrase "國際象棋錦標賽" could mean "International Chess Championship". Usually refers to the Chess Olympiad. So answer: Russia. Provide details.
